title: Global Forecast System (GFS): near-surface wind, temperature, pressure, precipitation and radiation, analyses and forecasts
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction, aggregated as a best time series by PacIOOS ERDDAP (ncep_global)

start.description: First time (UTC); the dataset holds past analyses and the latest forecast

end.description: Last time (UTC); forecasts reach about seven days ahead

step_hours.description: Hours between times: a multiple of 3

stride.description: Take every n-th point of the 0.5° grid: 2 gives 1°

variables.description: Comma-separated: ugrd10m, vgrd10m (wind at 10 m), tmp2m, tmpsfc, prmslmsl, pratesfc, rh2m, dswrfsfc, dlwrfsfc, uswrfsfc, ulwrfsfc

forecast.description: Yesterday to five days ahead, every 6 h, 1° grid (about 40 MB)

glance.description: From now to two days ahead, every 12 h, 2° grid (about 2 MB)

fine.description: From now to three days ahead, every 3 h, 0.5° grid (about 300 MB)

radiation.description: Surface radiation budget, yesterday to two days ahead, every 3 h, 1° grid

format: netCDF classic; float32; latitude descending from 90° to −90°, longitude 0° to 359.5°; SI units (m s-1, K, Pa, kg m-2 s-1, W m-2)
coverage: Global, 0.5° grid, every 3 h, from 2022-12 to about seven days ahead
licence: US Government work, public domain; ERDDAP: "The data may be used and redistributed for free but is not intended for legal use, since it may contain inaccuracies."
citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction, Global Forecast System; served by the Pacific Islands Ocean Observing System (PacIOOS).
